channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: Citadel's Griffin Says US Has to 'Grow the Damn Economy'
item.description: Citadel founder and CEO Ken Griffin says the US has to "grow the damn economy." He says in order to do so, the US has to get Europe to grow its economy. He speaks to Bloomberg's Dani Burger at the Future of Global Markets Conference in New York. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily Podcast: SpaceX, Netflix Report Earnings
item.description:
The people, companies and trends shaping the global economy. Watch Carol and Tim LIVE every day on YouTube: http://bit.ly/3vTiACF
Netflix reported earnings for the third quarter that exceeded Wall Street expectations, but forecast a fourth consecutive quarter of slowing sales growth. Meanwhile, SpaceX reported revenue for the third quarter that beat the average analyst estimate, sending the companies shares rising in the aftermarket. Elon Musk’s satellite, rocket and artificial intelligence conglomerate posted $4.4 billion in net income for the quarter ended in September, far better than analysts’ average projection of $1.88 billion.
On today's episode:
Ed Ludlow, Co-Host of Bloomberg Tech George Ferguson, Bloomberg Intelligence Global Head of Aerospace, Defense & Airline Analysis Brody Ford, Bloomberg New Tech Reporter Prashant Gopal, Bloomberg News US Real Estate Reporter (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Cboe’s Mandy Xu on Market Volatility
item.description: Mandy Xu, Vice President and Head of Derivatives Market Intelligence at Cboe Global Markets, says options-market sentiment shifted notably over the past week. After positioning had been broadly bullish at both the index and single-stock levels, investors increased hedging demand, particularly for index protection. She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Jess Menton on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Can Japan’s Economy Afford Takaichi’s Gamble?
item.description: A year after taking power, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi is betting ¥370 trillion ($2.3 trillion) on reviving Japan’s economy. But can she deliver growth without adding to the country’s enormous debt? (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Early Voting Data Shows Democratic Edge in Midterm Elections
item.description: The figures are consistent with other data pointing to a favorable environment for Democrats.
item.dc:creator: Gregory Korte

item.title: Has Sanae Takaichi Made Japan Great Again?
item.description: Sanae Takaichi promised a stronger Japan through bold investment and an assertive global role. One year in, how much has she delivered and what comes next? (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Sanae Takaichi Marks One Year as Japan’s Prime Minister: Big Take Asia
item.description: Japan’s Prime Minister has broken the mold for the country’s leaders. Can her $2 trillion economic gamble survive inflation at home and pressure overseas?
item.dc:creator: K Oanh Ha and Naomi Ng

item.title: Nscale Anthropic in AI Computing Talks
item.description: Nscale, the AI cloud computing firm, is in talks to sell computing power to Anthropic in a deal that could be worth about $45 billion. Brody Ford, Bloomberg News Tech Reporter, has the details on the possible deal. Plus, Bloomberg News Senior Editor for Equities Eric Weiner previews tech earnings expected after the close, including Netflix. As out US Equities Reporter Carmen Reinecke reports, the media company needs blockbuster hits to reverse its $135B wipeout. Plus, Washington Correspondent Tyler Kendall helps examine the possible geopolitical fallout of President Trump's rift with Ukrainian President Zelenskyy. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Zelenskyy's Feud With Trump Endangers Plans to Defend Ukraine
item.description: Bloomberg's Tyler Kendall said that Ukraine President Zelenskyy described meetings between US and Ukrainian representatives in Oslo as 'constructive' against the backdrop of his increasingly contentious relationship with President Trump. Kendall also discussed the latest with the Iran war, saying that strikes in the Strait of Hormuz have escalated and the pace of attacks and damage that the ships are sustaining is ramping up as Iran shifts to using drones instead of missiles. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Red Districts in Range for Democrats
item.description: On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondents Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz discuss the latest from the White House. On today's show, Fortius Global CEO Jim Messina, Harvard Kennedy School Ash Center Visiting Democracy Fellow Jeanne Sheehan Zaino, Jersey 1st Founder Rosemary Becchi and University of Virginia Miller Center Senior Fellow Mara Ruderman. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Crypto On The Ballot, Liquid Hack Fallout, AI Crypto Commerce
item.description: "Bloomberg Crypto" covers the people, transactions, and technology shaping the world of decentralized finance. Today's guests: Blockstream Co-Founder & CEO Adam Back, Chainalysis Head of Research Eric Jarine, Jito Labs COO & Chief Legal Officer Rebecca Rettig, and Franklin Templeton Head of Innovation Sandy Kaul. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trump Says US Trade Deal With India Is ‘Pretty Close’
item.description: President Donald Trump said the US and India are close to finalizing a trade deal after more than a year of negotiations.
item.dc:creator: Hadriana Lowenkron and Courtney Subramanian

item.title: Ukraine Hopes to Reconnect to Starlink in 48 Hours
item.description: Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says he spoke about intelligence sharing with US envoy Steve Witkoff during talks in Norway. Zelenskyy also said he hopes Ukraine’s connection to the Starlink Satellite network will be restored “maybe in 48 hours." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Iran, China & Russia Look to Seize on Election Opportunity, Says Mara Rudman
item.description: Mara Rudman, senior fellow at the University of Virginia's Miller Center and former US State Department official, said that one of the challenges facing the United States is that President Trump sees himself as 'part of the club' of leaders including Putin and Xi. Rudman said that countries like Iran, China and Russia are looking to 'maximize the opportunities' they have to create instability during the US midterm elections and the presidential election in Israel. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Zelenskyy Touts Positive US Talks as Trump Puts Pressure on Kyiv
item.description: Volodymyr Zelenskyy sought to draw a line under the escalating feud with the US after meeting with Donald Trump’s envoys in Oslo, while the US president kept up pressure on Kyiv.
item.dc:creator: Volodymyr Verbianyi and Ott Ummelas

item.title: Dems Line Up Legal Defenses as Trump Resurfaces Election Fraud Claims
item.description: Jim Messina, CEO of Fortius Global, said that he is watching voter enthusiasm numbers in the final two weeks leading up to the midterm elections and sees Democrats with a wide lead in those polls. Messina, a consultant who was former President Barack Obama's 2012 campaign manager, said Democrats are also preparing to defend the election results and are lining up lawyers 'to make sure that we actually have a free and fair election' as President Trump resurfaces election fraud claims. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Midterm Politics Played Into Clarity Failure: Rettig
item.description: Rebecca Rettig, COO and chief legal officer of Jito Labs, joins Scarlet Fu and James Seyffart on "Bloomberg Crypto." They discuss crypto's role 2026 US midterm elections and how recent regulatory innovation exemptions have lessoned the impact of the Clarity Act failing. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trump Administration Sued Over 50% Tariffs on Canadian Goods
item.description: The Trump administration is being sued over the imposition of 50% tariffs on an array of Canadian goods, the latest in a string of cases that broadly accuse the president of trying to achieve his trade agenda by asserting a taxing power that belongs to Congress.
item.dc:creator: Zoe Tillman

item.title: California Says Non-Citizen Voting Suit Borders on ‘Absurd’
item.description: California asked a judge to deny a Trump administration request to make the state set aside mail-in ballots of 20,000 suspected non-citizens, saying the lawsuit is at best a “reckless political stunt” in the run-up to the Nov. 3 midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: Erik Larson

item.title: Trump Builds Latin America Military Alliance Cheaply
item.description: Donald Trump has slashed US aid to Latin America even as country after country has elected governments aligned with him.
item.dc:creator: Maya Averbuch
